criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: The action history claims the agent found a visible “Best sellers” list, but the provided screenshots do not corroborate reaching or viewing a “Best sellers” section (or clearly equivalent best-selling list). Since this criterion is specifically about navigating to/locating that section and there’s no visual confirmation, the baseline should be reduced to partial credit for reasonable attempt (scrolling/navigating to Games) but not confirmed success.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: Opening a product page is clearly evidenced, but provenance from a “Best sellers” section is not visually verifiable. Award partial credit (product page opened on Xbox.com, but the ‘from Best sellers’ requirement is not confirmed by screenshots).

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All three required fields are present on the product page per screenshot 7, but the agent failed to report the publisher and incorrectly claimed it wasn’t visible. This is a substantive omission/contradiction relative to the evidence. Give credit for correctly reporting 2 of 3 fields (developer and release date), but penalize for missing the publisher that is clearly shown.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected: no sign-in, no purchase/download initiated. The agent also effectively stopped at reporting (attempting to report) details. Full credit.
